These adjustment shall be inclusive of the salary adjustment and additional COLA authorized in
Executive Order NO. 31 as implemented by National Compensation Circular No. 41.

Funds needed to implement this Order shall be drawn from salary lapses and other savings in the
Bureau's programmed appropriations. Any remaining deficiency shall be covered by the Bureau's excess
income. Further deficiency shall be charge to the balance, if any, of the Salary Adjustment fund provided in
the General Appropriations Act after payment of approved general across-the-board increases and adjustments
on cost of living allowance.

The Ministry of the Budget shall issue the necessary rules and regulations to implement the provisions
of this Order.
This Executive Order takes effect July 1, 1986.
Done in the City of Manila, this 10th day of December Nineteen Hundred and Eighty-Six.
